## Story DD Coverage
DD4: startup credential check; strict provider_chain parsing

## Implementation
Add to providers/config.py:
- parse_provider_chain(config_path=None) -> list[str]: reads ci_review.provider_chain from config; validates each name is lowercase canonical (anthropic, openai); trims whitespace; raises ConfigError on unknown/invalid names
- validate_provider_credentials(chain: list[str]) -> None: for each provider, checks API key env var; raises ConfigError with clear message if missing

  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check passes

- [ ] parse_provider_chain importable
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers.config import parse_provider_chain"
- [ ] Unknown provider raises ConfigError
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers.config import parse_provider_chain, ConfigError; parse_provider_chain('/tmp/test-chain.conf')" 2>&1 | grep -q "ConfigError\|ERROR" || true
